# fly Provider

Manage Fly.io Machines API resources: apps, machines, IPs, secrets, volumes, ACME certificates, and cert validation gates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "fly" {
  org_slug = "my-org"
  # api_token defaults to FLY_API_TOKEN; use an org token from
  # `fly tokens create org my-org`.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_slug` (String) Fly.io organization slug.

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Fly.io API token. Defaults to the FLY_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Override the Machines API server URL, without the `/v1` path — e.g. `http://_api.internal:4280` from inside a Fly machine. Defaults to `https://api.machines.dev`.
